# Stefan Yasin

> Technical operations, infrastructure and AI systems for small business. Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Runs Cloud and Cable, an IT services and AI delivery business for SMBs, and publishes open source operations tooling.

Stefan Yasin builds and operates systems: industrial IT and plant infrastructure, datacenter buildouts, electrical and power systems, cloud and AI solutions architecture, and conversational AI run like production infrastructure. Over 500,000 validated AI interactions across production pipelines. Seventeen open source tools released under MIT.

## Pages

- [Home](https://stefanyasin.com/): positioning, selected work, conversational AI service, recent writing, FAQ.
- [Work](https://stefanyasin.com/work/): case studies of systems built and operated, including a private renovation tracker on Cloudflare.
- [Haloz project board case study](https://stefanyasin.com/work/haloz-project-board/): per-person auth, bills of materials by trade, private document storage on R2, audit trail, shareable lists, and the platform constraints that shaped the build.
- [Writing](https://stefanyasin.com/blog/): essays, notes and LinkedIn posts on infrastructure, AI for small business, and operations.
- [About](https://stefanyasin.com/about/): background across industrial IT, datacenter work, electrical, and AI.
- [Contact](https://stefanyasin.com/contact/): email and phone.
